BiblicalUsage: Apt to teach is the mark of the overseer, and Paul requires it twice, of the bishop and of the servant of the Lord. He must be able to teach, gentle unto all men, and ready to instruct those who oppose themselves.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe aptness to teach is a gift of patience as much as of knowledge; the overseer must know the truth, but he must also be gentle enough to teach it to those who oppose it, which is the harder half.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
